```{ojs}
Tabulator = window.Tabulator
```



## Outlier Visualizer



```{ojs}
// load data

l3_pce_outliers_log = FileAttachment("data/l3_outliers_checked/logs/l3_pce_outliers_log.csv")
  .csv()
  .then(data => {
    return data.map(d => {
      let cleanedRow = {};

      for (let key in d) {
        let val = d[key];

        if (val === "" || val === "NA" || val === null || val === undefined) {
          cleanedRow[key] = null;
        }
        else if (key === "date" || isNaN(val) || isNaN(Number(val))) {
          cleanedRow[key] = val;
        }
        else {
          cleanedRow[key] = Number(val);
        }
      }

      return cleanedRow;
    })
  })

l3_pce = FileAttachment("data/l3_outliers_checked/consolidated/l3_pce.csv")
  .csv()
  .then(data => {
    return data.map(d => {
      let cleanedRow = {};

      for (let key in d) {
        let val = d[key];

        if (val === "" || val === "NA" || val === null || val === undefined) {
          cleanedRow[key] = null;
        }
        else if (key === "date" || isNaN(val) || isNaN(Number(val))) {
          cleanedRow[key] = val;
        }
        else {
          cleanedRow[key] = Number(val);
        }
      }

      return cleanedRow;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
  })
```

```{ojs}
// dropdown selections

communities = [...new Set(l3_pce_outliers_log.map(d => d.sales_reporting_name))]

viewof selectedCommunity = Inputs.select(
  communities,
  { label: "Community:", value: communities[0] }
)

availableColumns = {
  const subset = l3_pce_outliers_log.filter(d => d.sales_reporting_name === selectedCommunity);
  return [...new Set(subset.map(d => d.column_tested))];
}

viewof selectedColumn = Inputs.select(
  availableColumns,
  { label: "Column:", value: availableColumns[0] }
)
```

```{ojs}
// filter data

filteredFullSeries = l3_pce.filter(d =>
  d.sales_reporting_name === selectedCommunity
)

filteredOutliers = l3_pce_outliers_log.filter(d =>
  d.sales_reporting_name === selectedCommunity &&
  d.column_tested === selectedColumn
)

```





```{ojs}
// plot lines, dots, outlier dots

Plot.plot({
  height: 500,
  width: 1000,
  grid: false,
  x: {
    type: "utc",
    label: "Date",
    ticks: 20,
    tickFormat: "%Y"
  },
  y: {
    label: selectedColumn !== "All" ? selectedColumn : "Value",
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    // timeseries line
    Plot.line(filteredFullSeries, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d[selectedColumn],
      stroke: "#ccc",
      strokeWidth: 1.5
    }),

    // timeseries dots
    Plot.dot(filteredFullSeries, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d[selectedColumn],
      fill: "#888888",
      r: 3,
      tip: true
    }),

    // outlier dots
    Plot.dot(filteredOutliers, {
      x: "date",
      y: d => d.raw_value ?? d.value,
      fill: "red",
      stroke: "black",
      strokeWidth: 1,
      r: 6,
      tip: true
    })
  ]
})
```





## Decision Table

```{ojs}
tableContainer = {
  const container = html`<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"></div>`;

  const table = new Tabulator(container, {
    data: filteredOutliers,
    layout: "fitColumns",
    columns: [
      { title: "Community", field: "sales_reporting_name" },
      { title: "Date", field: "date" },
      { title: "Column", field: "column_tested"},
      { title: "Flagged Outlier", field: "raw_value" },
      {
        title: "Decision",
        field: "status",
        editor: "list",
        editorParams: { values: ["Use Suggested Imputation", "Set as NA", "Manual Override"] }
      },
      {
        title: "Manual Override Value",
        field: "override",
        editor: "input"
      }
    ]
  });

  window.currentTable = table;
  return container;
}
```
